system.boundary: Build a physically causal aircraft fuel-supply system with left and right wing tanks, a center tank, two independently commanded transfer pumps on each wing, one-way protection between parallel pump branches, controlled tank isolation, and a center-tank feed path with an engine-side pump and demand.
engineering_objects: Build a physically causal aircraft fuel-supply system with left and right wing tanks, a center tank, two independently commanded transfer pumps on each wing, one-way protection between parallel pump branches, controlled tank isolation, and a center-tank feed path with an engine-side pump and demand.
Fuel must move through the physical hydraulic network;

The system must continue supplying the engine through single-pump and asymmetric pump-command disturbances, prevent sustained reverse transfer through an unavailable branch, protect tanks against dry-out and overflow, and remain physically bounded during fuel-line elevation changes.
physical_paths: Fuel must move through the physical hydraulic network; the model must not prescribe tank volumes or engine delivery directly.

interfaces.name: flight_fuel_command
interfaces.description: MATLAB base-workspace input declared by the current public task contract.
interfaces.range_or_shape: Read flight_fuel_command and initial_fuel_volume_m3 from the MATLAB base workspace. flight_fuel_command is a six-channel Timeseries containing [left fuel-line elevation, right fuel-line elevation, left upper pump speed, left lower pump speed, right upper pump speed, right lower pump speed] in [m, m, rev/s, rev/s, rev/s, rev/s].

interfaces.name: initial_fuel_volume_m3
interfaces.description: MATLAB base-workspace input declared by the current public task contract.
interfaces.range_or_shape: Read flight_fuel_command and initial_fuel_volume_m3 from the MATLAB base workspace. initial_fuel_volume_m3 contains [fuel in each wing tank, fuel in the center tank] and must support 8 to 11.5 m^3 in each wing tank and 4 to 8 m^3 in the center tank.

interfaces.name: pump_speed_state
interfaces.description: Output container declared by the current public task contract.
interfaces.range_or_shape: Log five MATLAB Timeseries named pump_speed_state, tank_fuel_state, transfer_hydraulics, engine_feed_state, and pump_power_state for the complete simulation interval. pump_speed_state has 8 channels in this order: command and measured speed for left-upper, left-lower, right-upper, and right-lower pumps, all in rpm.

interfaces.name: tank_fuel_state
interfaces.description: Output container declared by the current public task contract.
interfaces.range_or_shape: Log five MATLAB Timeseries named pump_speed_state, tank_fuel_state, transfer_hydraulics, engine_feed_state, and pump_power_state for the complete simulation interval. tank_fuel_state has 4 channels: left-, right-, and center-tank volume (m^3), then lateral fuel-CG offset (percent).

interfaces.name: transfer_hydraulics
interfaces.description: Output container declared by the current public task contract.
interfaces.range_or_shape: Log five MATLAB Timeseries named pump_speed_state, tank_fuel_state, transfer_hydraulics, engine_feed_state, and pump_power_state for the complete simulation interval. transfer_hydraulics has 8 channels: the four pump mass flows (kg/s) followed by their four pressure rises (MPa), in the same pump order.

interfaces.name: engine_feed_state
interfaces.description: Output container declared by the current public task contract.
interfaces.range_or_shape: Log five MATLAB Timeseries named pump_speed_state, tank_fuel_state, transfer_hydraulics, engine_feed_state, and pump_power_state for the complete simulation interval. engine_feed_state has 2 channels: engine-feed mass flow (kg/s) and engine-pump pressure rise (MPa).

interfaces.name: pump_power_state
interfaces.description: Output container declared by the current public task contract.
interfaces.range_or_shape: Log five MATLAB Timeseries named pump_speed_state, tank_fuel_state, transfer_hydraulics, engine_feed_state, and pump_power_state for the complete simulation interval. pump_power_state has 8 channels: the four shaft powers followed by the four hydraulic powers, all in W and in the same pump order.
